description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of various topics or categories, consisting of a total of twelve distinct slices. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie and connected to their respective slices via thin gray lines. Moving clockwise from the top right, the chart displays a large blue slice with a redacted or obscured label accounting for 24.3%, followed by a red slice for Business (5.9%), a yellow-gold slice for Geography (2.7%), a dark green slice for Math (1.2%), a bright orange slice for Game&Anime (8.2%), a teal slice for Econ. & Fin. (18.4%), a light blue slice for Science (6.7%), a light red or pink slice for Law (5.1%), a yellow slice for History (8.2%), a light green slice for Med & Health (6.7%), a light orange slice for Pet & Animal (5.5%), and a cyan slice for Daily Life (7.1%). The segments do not appear to be ordered by size, such as in ascending or descending order, and none of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
